LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Settled.Title: DEBT_SETTLED//Debt write-off report
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Settled.Intro: Dear interstellar citizen,\n\nWe are pleased to inform you that every asset-backed agreement filed with the Debt Management Department has now been formally written off. Across a long and difficult settlement process, you showed an exceptional level of commitment. Despite the unpredictable risks of this rimworld, you have proven that credit is the most widely accepted currency of all.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Settled.Close: Your credit history has been filed, and the Debt Management Department has ended risk monitoring of your account. We trust you will maintain this exceptional standard of compliance in the years ahead.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Liquidation.Title: LIQUIDATION_COMPLETE//Asset liquidation confirmation
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Liquidation.Intro: The process has begun. The target assets have been located, and the Debt Management Department will now carry out final liquidation. Everything is being done in accordance with regulation.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Liquidation.Body: The wailing alarm was cut short by a shriek from the sky. You looked up and saw dozens of vast steel clamps punch through the clouds, dragging orange trails behind them. With a violent clang of metal the roof under your feet shattered, and through the billowing smoke and dust, the heavy hum of hydraulic clamps closing became the last thing you ever heard of your home. You felt yourself seized and dragged upward, your face wrapped in a cold oxygen mask and sealing spray. The thrusters lit again, and gravity turned over entirely. You saw the crops you had tended, the bricks you had laid by hand, and your terrified companions, all falling away beneath you...\n\nOr rather, you were the one rising, faster and faster, into the endless dark. Before the suffocating silence took everything, the last thing you saw was that desolate land below, where all you had ever cared for disappeared into the rising dust.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Liquidation.CapturedAssets: {0} has been delivered as collateral against overdue payments.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Liquidation.Close: The dust has settled. The land falls silent again, waiting for the next poor soul.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.NegotiationText: Given your unauthorized interference with the collection process, the Debt Management Department has judged the cost of writing off this bad debt to be excessive. Your debt package has been sold to a third party: {0}.\n\nBecause the nature of the debt has changed, late payment penalties have raised your arrears to {2} silver. The financial link will be formally closed within 24 hours. After that, your credit record will no longer exist - only a new creditor, with an open-ended claim on your assets.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.Option.Pay: Pay the new creditor in silver ({0})
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.Option.Refuse: Refuse. Prepare for liquidation in {0} days.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.BuyoutFail: Payment failed: the silver on this map ({0}) is not enough to settle the debt ({1}). Prepare for the attack.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.BuyoutSuccess: {0} has received the silver, and every one of your debts is written off in full under interstellar law.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.CountdownText: USAC has formally exited your debt contract. {0} now holds the right to dispose of all your assets, and they have issued an ultimatum: a full seizure operation begins in {1} days.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.SiegeStartText: The armed collection team sent by {0} has arrived. They intend to break your will with relentless attacks over the next {1} days. Endure, or pay in blood.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.VictoryText: After paying a heavy price, {0} has formally abandoned enforcement of this debt - the losses were simply too great. Your debt is now marked "overdue and void," and no faction will trouble you over it again.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.Credits.Title: DEBT_ASSIGNMENT//Report on transfer of claims
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.Credits.Intro: {0} has purchased your debt, valued at ₿{1}, from the Debt Management Department on the secondary market.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.Credits.Body: Note: the Debt Management Department always strives for efficiency and balance. When the cost of hedging a risk outweighs its return, transferring the asset package to a local third party with the capacity to receive it is standard procedure.\n\nThank you for being our credit client. We wish you luck in your future asset restructuring.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.Credits.Close: "The financial link has been safely disconnected."
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.Victory.Title: WAR_OF_DEBT//The final war of debt
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.Victory.Body: You solved your financial troubles in the oldest and most thorough way there is: you killed the creditors.\n\nAfter days of bloody defense, they finally understood that collecting from a band of fanatical colonists armed to the teeth was a losing proposition. As the last commando squad pulled back, the shackles of debt broke for good. Freedom always has a price, and you paid yours in full - in your creditors' blood.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.SilverBuyout.Title: SILVER_SETTLEMENT//Silver repayment report
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.SilverBuyout.Body:
{0} confirms receipt of {1} silver in full. Your debt status has been updated to "settled."
For a moment, the data flowing through the orbital settlement network stalled. The Debt Management Department's risk model verified the transaction's legality again and again, and still could not make sense of it. You held an enormous silver reserve and countless ways to convert it into instruments we recognize, yet you sat on it through settlement cycle after settlement cycle, waited out the debt transfer, and then bought the whole thing out in cash at once.
Silver is worthless to the USAC orbital settlement network - our systems recognize only specific payment credentials. But {0} clearly does not mind. They will feed this silver into the local trade network and recover their costs through a long, inefficient chain of resales. For a faction that had just taken on a non-performing asset, the windfall was enough to leave their finance director staring at the wall for three minutes.
Operations like this are exceedingly rare in our records. Usually only two kinds of people attempt them: financial talents who found an arbitrage window in the gray area of debt transfer, or gamblers who enjoy being hunted for money, proving in the most expensive way possible that rules are merely suggestions once you are rich enough.
Whichever you are, you have proven one thing: on this rimworld, there is always someone who will reach their goal by the most absurd route available.
LanguageData.USAC.Ending.Transfer.SilverBuyout.Close:
The Debt Management Department has filed this case as "atypical settlement behavior" and recommends that future risk models account for "deliberate delay despite capacity to pay."
The dust has settled. Your credit record is gone from the system, replaced by a single cold entry: "Settled (silver buyout)."

LanguageData.USAC.Alert.SiegeCountdown.ExplanationAct: Defense time remaining: {0}\n\nYou are under sustained attack from {1}. Hold out until the time runs down and the losses will force them to abandon their claim.
LanguageData.USAC_DebtSite_WarningLetterText: Given your default during the {0} settlement process, the Debt Management Department has classified your credit rating as "high-risk default." All external credit access has been locked at the same time. We advise you to resume compliant performance immediately, before the security procedure escalates further.
LanguageData.USAC_DebtSite_EscalationLetterText: Because asset preservation efforts against {0} continue to meet obstruction, the Debt Management Department has concluded that conventional recovery is ineffective. We will therefore attempt no further direct settlement communication with you. Automated assessment systems will take over from here. Based on security feedback, those systems will establish whatever long-term on-site preservation facilities they deem necessary near your location, and their conduct will depend entirely on how compliant the situation remains. Be advised that all secondary damage arising from this is borne by the defaulting party.
LanguageData.USAC.UI.Assets.TransferLocked.Title: ACCOUNT_TERMINATED//Confirmation of offshore transfer of asset package
LanguageData.USAC.UI.Assets.TransferLocked.Desc: Service notice: under the risk management agreement, and following the classification of your credit model as a non-performing asset, the Debt Management Department has completed the offshore transfer of this bad debt. The stripping of these assets is irreversible.\n\nUSAC has formally terminated your interface access, and your account is now logically segregated. All further valuation and recovery procedures will be carried out independently by the trustee faction. We wish you well in the new cycle.
LanguageData.USAC.UI.Assets.Negotiation.Title: QUASI-LEGAL_SETTLEMENT//Default settlement proposal
LanguageData.USAC.UI.Assets.Negotiation.Available: Our systems have detected positive cash flow in your account. The Debt Management Department has authorized a "second chance" asset recovery window. We can discuss how to rebuild our partnership.
LanguageData.USAC.UI.Assets.Negotiation.Locked: Under the Patriot Financial Security Act, your account is currently under punitive control. We must observe at least two consecutive acts of proactive compliance (current progress: {0}/2) before a compliance officer will step in to reassess your risk. Please continue to demonstrate your commitment.
